title: Injective augmented Cech resolution on a total simplicial site
statement:
Let $\mathcal C_p$ ($p\ge0$) and $\mathcal D$ be small sites in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and let $u_\alpha:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C_q)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C_p)$, for $\alpha:[p]\to[q]$ in the simplex category of [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object], be geometric morphisms [def-trf-geometric-morphism] with specified identity and composition isomorphisms satisfying the cocycle laws. Let $a_p:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C_p)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)$ be a compatible augmentation. Form the total topos of families $F_p$ with maps $u_\alpha^{-1}F_p\to F_q$ obeying these coherences, write $r_pF=F_p$, and let $a$ be the geometric morphism whose inverse image sends $G$ to the family $(a_p^{-1}G)_p$. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring and use modules over its constant ring sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every injective total module $I$ [def-sp-injective-resolutions], the canonical augmented complex
$$0\longrightarrow a_*I\longrightarrow a_{0,*}r_0I\longrightarrow a_{1,*}r_1I\longrightarrow a_{2,*}r_2I\longrightarrow\cdots$$
is exact in every degree and remains exact after applying $\operatorname{Hom}_{\Lambda_{\mathcal D}}(G,-)$ for any module $G$ on $\mathcal D$. Here the $i$-th coface $a_{p,*}I_p\to a_{p+1,*}I_{p+1}$ is $a_{p,*}$ of $I_p\to u_{i,*}u_i^*I_p\to u_{i,*}I_{p+1}$ followed by $a_{p,*}u_{i,*}\simeq a_{p+1,*}$, the differential is their alternating sum, and the augmentation is the component of the counit $a^*a_*I\to I$ transposed under $a_0^*\dashv a_{0,*}$. These maps are natural in $I$.
